plain_language_result: The three frozen mathematical claims survive exact attack. The phase map is an exact solution-space equivalence with the standard defocusing cubic NLS, the squared dispersion is the unit-background linearization, and the additive shift is the zero-background linearization under the frozen convention. The historical squared record matches v0 only as an explicit parameter-mapped special limit; the additive historical record lacks enough bound background, gauge, and perturbation context for a stronger classification.

claim_adjudications.statement_established: For every permitted L, kappa, interval I, and initial datum psi0, phi=exp(-i kappa t)psi maps the frozen weak-solution set bijectively to the comparator cubic defocusing NLS weak-solution set on the same interval, with inverse psi=exp(i kappa t)phi and unchanged data at t=0.
direct_proof: Let p(t)=exp(-i kappa t). Then p_t=-i kappa p, p_x=0, |p|=1, and phi=p psi.
The exact residual identity is R_NLS[p psi]=p R_CCFT[psi]. Direct expansion cancels the isolated background shift without assuming either residual is zero.
The inverse multiplier p^{-1}=exp(i kappa t) satisfies p^{-1}p=pp^{-1}=1, so the residual implication holds in both directions.
Because p is spatially constant and unit modulus, multiplication by p preserves periodicity and the H1_per and Hminus1_per spatial classes at every t.
The smooth time multiplier and the permitted Hminus1 product rule preserve the declared C and C1 time classes and do not change the existence interval.
At t=0, p(0)=1, so phi(0)=psi(0)=psi0. At kappa=0, p=1 and the bijection is the identity.
claim_adjudications.claim_boundary: This proves exact mathematical equivalence of the frozen v0 equation to a known cubic NLS equation. It does not prove physical coherence, empirical validity, or distinctively CCFT dynamics.

claim_adjudications.statement_established: The real Frechet linearization about psi=1 is a_t=-(1/2)b_xx and b_t=(1/2)a_xx-2 kappa a. Under the frozen Fourier convention a nonzero complexified modal amplitude exists exactly when omega^2=(q^2/2)(q^2/2+2 kappa)=q^4/4+kappa q^2.
direct_proof: For psi=1+epsilon(a+i b), |psi|^2-1=2 epsilon a+O(epsilon^2), so the first-order nonlinearity is 2 kappa epsilon a.
Separating real and imaginary parts of i(a_t+i b_t)=-(1/2)(a_xx+i b_xx)+2 kappa a gives the frozen real system with the stated signs.
For exp(i(qx-omega t)), set A=q^2/2 and B=q^2/2+2 kappa. The modal matrix is [[-i omega,-A],[B,-i omega]].
Its determinant is -omega^2+AB. A nonzero kernel exists exactly when the determinant vanishes, which yields the frozen squared relation.
The algebraic identity AB=q^4/4+kappa q^2 is exact.

edge_cases.q_zero_kappa_positive: The determinant has a double zero frequency and a nonzero pure-phase eigenvector. A separate real-amplitude generalized direction produces secular phase growth; this does not refute the frozen modal proposition.
edge_cases.q_zero_kappa_zero: The zero matrix admits nonzero zero-frequency amplitudes.
edge_cases.kappa_zero: The relation reduces to omega^2=q^4/4, the two signed branches of the linear Schrodinger dispersion.

claim_adjudications.constructed_nonzero_amplitude: For q nonzero and omega^2=AB, (U,V)=(A,-i omega) is a nonzero kernel vector. For q=0 and omega=0, (U,V)=(0,1) is a nonzero kernel vector.

claim_adjudications.statement_established: The Frechet linearization about psi=0 is i eta_t=-(1/2)eta_xx-kappa eta. Every nonzero Fourier amplitude under exp(i(qx-omega t)) satisfies omega=q^2/2-kappa, and the opposite time-frequency convention reverses the entire frequency sign.
direct_proof: At psi=epsilon eta, the cubic term kappa|psi|^2 psi is O(epsilon^3), while the background-shift term is -kappa epsilon eta.
Substitution of A exp(i(qx-omega t)) with A nonzero gives omega A=(q^2/2-kappa)A, hence the frozen additive relation.
Replacing exp(i(qx-omega t)) by exp(i(qx+omega t)) maps omega to -omega, not merely the interaction term.
Under phi=exp(-i kappa t)psi, the comparator carrier frequency is omega_phi=omega_psi+kappa=q^2/2; the uniform -kappa shift is gauge dependent while |phi|=|psi|.
